column3: Raises the reputations of an award winner: for a player, the world, home and current reputations rise by a fraction of the award's reputations (up to 10000 and at least them); for a non-player, they rise up to the award floors and the board confidence gains 1000. `award_raise_winner_reputation(person, club, nation, world, player)`, called for the player-of-the-month slot (`set_winner`) and for the yearly and national side awards. A player (`.player()`) in a player award: world (`player_sheet::WORLD_REPUTATION`) + 5% (`rdata::F64_0_05`) of the award's world reputation, up to 10000 and at least that value; home (`player_sheet::HOME_REPUTATION`): for the club of his own nation (`.nation()` of the club = `.nation()` of the person), + 10% (`rdata::F64_0_1`) of the national reputation and at least that value; otherwise + 2.5% (`rdata::F64_0_025`) of the sum and at least the average; current (`player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`) + 10% of the national reputation, at least that value; puts the player in the clubs' lists (`exe::shortlist_manager_add_player_to_club_shortlists`, with 1) if the list manager exists. A non-player (`.non_player()`) in a non-player award: the three rise to the floors (`.world_reputation()` world, `.home_reputation()` by the club's nation, `.current_reputation()` national) and, with a club, the board confidence (+6 of the 73-byte row of `G_MANAGER_MANAGER`) + 1000, between 6500 and 10000. Only the low words of the reputations count.

Finds the nth club of a nation in the South American club table, optionally skipping clubs already qualified and clubs with a human manager. `ConmebolSeeding::find_nth_unqualified_club_of_nation`; this is not read; the same code as UEFA's `uefa_find_nth_unplaced_club_of_nation`. In the South American club table (12-byte records sorted by nation: +0 the club, +4 the nation id), a binary search (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with 0x905ce0; the key holds only the nation and +8 = 0xff) finds a club of the nation; it steps back to the first club of the nation, then walks to the `n`th (char, 1 = the first) that counts, skipping, on request (`without_slot`, `without_human`), those that already have a place (`.continental_comp_id()` ≠ −1) and those with a human manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`(club, 0, 1, 0, 0)). The table is sorted by nation and, within it, by division, position and reputation. The last record of the table is never examined by the loop (if the loop reaches it with the count at zero, it is chosen without the tests). Returns the club if it belongs to the nation, otherwise 0.

Builds the CONMEBOL club table: South American and Mexican clubs (national teams excluded), each stripped of its continental place, sorted by nation. `collect_conmebol_clubs` (stdcall, ret 4). It allocates 12 bytes per club in the game (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the box for line 0xbb and returns 0) and stores the pointer in `*out`. For each club with a nation (`club::NATION`) that is not a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`) and is from Mexico (`KEY_NATION_MEXICO`) or from a South American nation (`.continent()` equal to the id of `KEY_CONTINENT_SOUTH_AMERICA`): it removes the continental place (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = −1) and writes the record (+0 the club, +4 the nation id, +8 the reputation `club::REPUTATION` / 500, +9 the `.reputation()` of the division `club::LAST_DIVISION`, `european_club_entry::LAST_POSITION` the `club::LAST_POSITION`; without a division −1 and 0x7f; with a division whose nation (`competition::NATION`) has no `.league_selected()`, the club's `club::LAST_DIVISION` and `club::LAST_POSITION` are zeroed). Within a nation the order is by division, position and reputation [inference: the division `.reputation()` and club `club::LAST_POSITION` fields]. It sorts by nation (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x905ce0). Returns the number of clubs (only the low 16 bits count).

The Libertadores calendar: every new game year it builds the CONMEBOL club table and gives out the places. `ConmebolSeeding::update_for_new_season`, called by the Libertadores and by the Mercosur. Without `skip` and with the game year (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`) different from `conmebol_seeding::LAST_SEASON_YEAR`: it stores the year, builds the club table (`exe::collect_conmebol_clubs`; if empty, the box for line 0x9b and it returns without freeing), gives the Libertadores places (`exe::conmebolseeding_assign_libertadores_places`) and frees the table (`exe::crt_free`).

writes CM3_TEMP\conmebol_seeding.tmp: the country count (`conmebol_seeding::NATION_COUNT`), 0xa bytes per country from +0, `conmebol_seeding::LAST_SEASON_YEAR` (u16) and `conmebol_seeding::BRA_CHAMP_CUP_WINNER_ID` (u32); on error the "Error" box without closing the file

rule: the English League Cup has 7 single-leg rounds, except the two-legged semi-final (21 days apart): 1st round drawn on 23/7 and played on 22/8; 2nd draw 23/8, match 20/9; 3rd 28/9 and 28/10; 4th 29/10 and 11/11; quarter-finals 12/11 and 2/12; semi-final 3/12 and 27/1 of the next year; final drawn 18/2, played on 1/4 at a neutral ground [inference: venue 4], dates moved to each one's weekday; clubs in Europe (`eng_cc_cup::EUROPEAN_ENTRANT_COUNT`) only enter in the 3rd round (1st round 2b + 56 teams, 2nd (32 − b) × 2, (12 − b) × 3 new entrants; the b enter in the 3rd); category 4 up to the 4th round and 6 after; no prize per round (−1)

rule: the League Cup takes the 92 clubs of the four English divisions, in the order Third, Second, First and Premier (outside the European cups), then those in European cups (counted in `eng_cc_cup::EUROPEAN_ENTRANT_COUNT`, at most 12: they enter in the 3rd round); each one's class orders the list (qsort, smallest first, ties by smallest reputation): 0 in the Third and Second, in the First 0x46 − position for clubs relegated from the Premier and 0x28 − position for the others, in the Premier 0x78 − position for clubs that stayed and 0x64 − position for promoted ones, 0x78 for the European clubs; after sorting the class becomes 1 (Premier), 2 (First) or 3

rule: the English League Cup is rebuilt once per season (`.season_set_up()`), on the first day the game year reaches the cup year: the old tables are freed and the 92 entrants, the 7 rounds, the tie tree and the predicted order are built; then, every day, the cup update (draws and matches on the table dates)

rule: the Coupe de France has 9 single-leg rounds, from the 6th national round (40 teams) to the final: 6th drawn 10/10 (no fixed weekday), played 6/11; 7th 12/11 and 27/11 (164 clubs enter, 184 teams); 8th 3/12 and 18/12; last 128 6/1 and 22/1 (18 enter); last 64 27/1 and 12/2; last 16 20/2 and 4/3; quarter-finals 5/3 and 19/3; semi-final 20/3 and 12/4; final drawn 13/4, played 6/5 at a neutral ground [inference: venue 4]; from the 7th round to the semi-final the lower-division club plays at home (`cup_round::DRAW_RULES` = 1); the prize (`cup_round::LOSER_PRIZE`) of 100 thousand in the last 16, 200 thousand in the quarter-finals, 400 thousand in the semi-final, and in the final 1 million (`cup_round::WINNER_PRIZE`) and 800 thousand (`cup_round::LOSER_PRIZE`); category 4 up to the last 16 and 6 after

rule: the Coupe de France takes 222 clubs, in this order (the order decides the entry round: the first 40 in the 6th round, the next 164 in the 7th and the last 18, the First Division, in the last 128): all clubs of division `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FRENCH_NATIONAL` (the National [inference]); those of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_A_LOWER_DIVISION` linked (`club::RESERVE_DIVISION`) to `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FRENCH_CFA` (the CFA [inference]); the French ones of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_A_LOWER_DIVISION` without a link; the French clubs with no division that are not national teams — these three groups up to 184 entrants in 2001 and 182 in other years; the Second and the First Division; with an incomplete list it returns 0

rule: the Japanese Super Cup is between the J1 champion and the Emperor's Cup winner; a winner with no nation (`club::NATION` = 0, a club that no longer exists [inference]) gives the place to the runner-up; if it is the same club, the Emperor's Cup runner-up comes in and, if they still coincide, the J1 runner-up; if one is missing, the error box

rule: the MLS All-Star Game pits the two conference all-star teams (`G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_EAST` and `G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_WEST`, clubs in the table); in odd years the `G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_EAST` team is at home, in even years the `G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_WEST` one; the stadium is that of an MLS club drawn (1 in 6, in table order) among the home conference's clubs (0x413 in odd years, 0x414 in even ones); both teams get the USA nation [inference]

Rule: the MLS All-Star game is a single match between the two conference selections, drawn on 15/6 and played on 2/8 (moved to weekday 6) at the borrowed home ground [inference: venue 0], with no bracket draw (`cup_round::TIE_RULES` = 0x20 [inference]); category 8; no prize. `UsaMlsAllStars::create_round_table(stage, &rounds, &extra, &out)` (virtual +0x3c of the All-Star Game): outside stage −1 (the byte), 0. On −1: out (if requested) = 0, rounds = 1, extra = 0; the table (`exe::crt_malloc` of 0x68; out of memory, the error box at line 0x9a and 0) with the single round: the draw on day 15 of month 5 (June) moved to weekday 5, the match on day 2 of month 7 (August) moved to weekday 6, leg 1, venue 0 (`exe::cup_set_round_draw_date` and `exe::cup_set_round_match_date`, cdecl, with the year `.year()`); name 0, `cup_round::TIE_RULES` = 0x20, category 8 (`match_category::CONTINENTAL_LATE_ROUND`), 2 teams, 1 match, 2 new, 1 match per tie, no prize.

Draws the Champions League first group phase: the 32 clubs sorted by pot, same-nation partners in opposite halves, the draw of the 8 groups pot by pot, the swap of same-nation clubs within a group, the coefficient, the 1,800,000 prize and its news, the 8 stages, and the third qualifying round losers into the UEFA Cup. SEH frame only for the stage's `new`: no destructor on the normal path. `EuropeanCup::draw_phase1_groups()`, called from the Champions League's next-stage routine (`european_cup_advance_stage`, stage 0). 1) The list of the 32 (`exe::crt_calloc`(0x20, 9): push 9; push 0x20; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; 9 bytes: +0 the club, +4 the same-nation partner, +8 the half: 1 groups A..D, 2 groups E..H; out of memory, the error box at line 0x4cc): the first 16 of table `.entrant_book()` (6 bytes) and the teams of table `.team_table()` (6 bytes) with +5 = 1 (the third qualifying round winners). Fewer than 32: the error box at line 0x4ee, `.current_stage()` = −1, the list freed and `.run_by_stages()` = 0. 2) The list is sorted by pot (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `european_cup_compare_clubs_by_seed`: the club's `club::EURO_SEEDING` and the reputation) and each club without a partner gets the first following club without a partner from the same nation (the two point at each other). 3) The groups (`exe::crt_calloc`(0x20, 4): 8 groups × 4 pots; out of memory, the error box at line 0x515 and the game stops): for each pot of 8 (k = 0..3), 4 slots start free in each half, minus those already marked; 8 times a club of the pot is drawn (`exe::utils_random`(8) + 8k, drawn again while the slot is already taken); without a half, one is drawn (`exe::utils_random`(free A + free B) < free B: the second) and the partner, if it is in the same pot, is put in the other half (with no slot there, it is not marked); the club enters the first group of the half with the pot free. 4) In each half and pot, a club with another club of the same nation in its group swaps places with the same-pot club of the first other group in the half without its nation. 5) Each group: the 4 clubs earn 1 point of the nation coefficient (`exe::uefaseeding_add_nation_points` on `G_UEFA_SEEDING`: push 1; push nation -> thiscall, ret 8), the 1,800,000 prize (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` on `G_FINANCE_TABLE` push club -> thiscall, ret 4; `exe::finance_add_prize_money` push amount; mov ecx, finances -> thiscall, ret 4) and the prize news (`exe::comp_send_prize_money_news`: push −2; push 0; push 0x449; push −1; push 0; push amount; push club; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x1c); the round table from method `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) and the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE`: this, 4, the group, 2, +4, the table, the rounds (word), 3, 1, 8, &{4,1,2,0}, &{2,0,0,0}, the year (word), g, the id (word), 0xf, 2, 0, 8, −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the year with garbage in the high bytes of edx, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes the clean year) into `.stages()`[g] (without a stage, the error box at line 0x5c9 and it returns, without freeing the table or the groups); the round table freed, `.current_stage()` = g and the group news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news`). 6) The groups are freed; the teams of `.team_table()` with +5 = 2 (the third qualifying round losers) go to the UEFA Cup (`[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE + 4 × [KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP]]`; without it, the error box at line 0x5d8): into the last 24 slots of its `.team_table()` (from `.team_count()` − 24), with +4 and +5 cleared, into its `.entrant_book()` with status 5 (`.entrant_count()` goes up) and with the club's European competition (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID`) = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP`; then the UEFA Cup's predicted positions (its method `comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`).
the pot comparison: the club's European seed (`club::EURO_SEEDING`), and on a tie the higher reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) first

Sets the Champions League predicted positions: the entrants sorted by strength, each one's predicted position taken from the knockout from the final back, the second and first group phases and the qualifying rounds. Method +0x5c of the Champions League: `EuropeanCup::rank_teams()`. Without statistics (+8): the error box at line 0x81b. The entrants of table `.entrant_book()` (6 bytes, `.entrant_count()` of them) go into an array (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the error box at line 0x823), sorted by strength (`exe::comp_util_sort_clubs_by_strength`: push n; push array; add esp, 8 -> cdecl); the knockout table from method `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push 0xc; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0x10), freed afterwards; each entrant's position, in array order, through `exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position` (push position; push club; mov ecx, `[+8]` -> thiscall, ret 8; the original pushes the stack dword with the position in the low byte and garbage in the others, and `exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position` writes only the byte: the copy passes the clean byte) following the plan in `planned_final_positions`; the array freed.

Draws the Champions League second group phase: the 16 qualifiers sorted, the same-group pairs, each one's group choice (shuffled order, fewest teams, no same first-phase group nor nation), the redraw up to 20 times, the coefficient, the 1,200,000 prize and its news, stages 8 to 11 and the third places into the UEFA Cup. SEH frame only for the stage's `new`: no destructor on the normal path. `EuropeanCup::draw_phase2_groups(attempt)`, called from the Champions League's next-stage routine (`european_cup_advance_stage`, stage 8, attempt 0). 1) The 16 qualifiers (`exe::crt_calloc`(0x10, 7); out of memory, the error box at line 0x61c): from each first-phase group b (`.stages()`[b]) the first and second of the table (`exe::league_get_table_row` push 0 / push 1; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4), with group b and 0/1; +4 counts the clubs in the list from the same nation (itself included); the list is sorted (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `european_cup_compare_phase2_draw_entries`) and each club's bookings are cleared in the competition's governing body (`exe::rulingbody_reset_bookings_for_club`, as in the World Cup draw). 2) The pairs from the same first-phase group (two cleared lists of 16; out of memory, the error boxes 0x649 and 0x651): each club still in the list goes to slot k (winner) or k + 1 (runner-up) and the other club of its group to the other one; k goes up by 2. 3) Each of the 16, in pair order: the order of the 4 groups is shuffled (5 swaps of `exe::utils_random`(4) and `exe::utils_random`(4)); the group with fewest teams among those that have a free slot in its half (winners in slots 0/1, runners-up in 2/3) and have no team from the same first-phase group nor from the same nation receives the club. 4) If a club is left without a group: with attempt < 20, the lists are freed and the draw is run again with attempt + 1 (the call nests inside this one); on the 20th, each leftover takes the first free slot (the club stays in the pairs list). 5) Each group h (0..3): the 4 clubs earn 1 coefficient point, the 1,200,000 prize and the news (`exe::comp_send_prize_money_news` with round 0x44a); stage h + 8 (method `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE`, `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) and the constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE` with the same arguments as the first-phase draw, the list of the 4 clubs copied into a 0x40-byte array (`exe::crt_malloc`); without a stage, the error box at line 0x715), `.current_stage()` = h + 8 and the group news. The four lists are freed. 6) The first-phase third places (`exe::league_get_table_row` push 2) go to the UEFA Cup (`[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE + 4 × [KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP]]`; without it, the error box at line 0x729): into the last 8 slots of its `.team_table()`, from back to front, into the `.entrant_book()` with status 5 and with the club's European competition = the UEFA Cup; the fourth places (push 3) are left without a European competition (−1); then the UEFA Cup's predicted positions (method `comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`).

The comparison for the second-phase qualifiers: more same-nation clubs first, then the higher nation word `nation::REPUTATION`, then the group winner before the runner-up. `european_cup_compare_phase2_draw_entries(a, b)`, the qsort comparison of the qualifiers (`draw_phase2_groups`): b's same-nation count (+4) minus a's; on a tie: the nation's word `nation::REPUTATION` (the club's `club::NATION`) of b minus a's; on a tie: a's +6 (the runner-up flag) minus b's.

Updates the staff records by outcome and stage: in qualifying, the qualified (`european_cup_add_qualified_record`) or knocked-out (`european_cup_add_knocked_out_record`) record weighted by round (`scale_by_round`); in the group stages, qualified (6) or failed to qualify (0xfe, `european_cup_add_failed_to_qualify_record`); in the knockout, winners (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_winners_record`), runners-up (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_runners_up_record`), qualified or knocked out; whoever leaves gets `club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = -1 (`leave_euro_competition`); returns 0. `EuropeanCup::update_staff_records_for_status(club, outcome, stage, _a, game, end)`, the Champions League's virtual +0x44. Returns 0. Comp = +4. - In qualifying (stage 0xff): outcome 0 or 1, the qualification by the fixture's round (`fixture::ROUND_NUMBER`): in round 0, with `.stage_label()` and the `cup_round::ROUND_CODE` + 0x68 (+0x6f) of the round table (`.round_table()`) and the weight `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, 0, 2); in any other, 0x41c, 0 and `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, round, 2). Outcome 0xff or 2: the elimination (`european_cup_add_knocked_out_record`) with the fixture's `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX` and `fixture::ROUND_NAME` and the weight `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, round, 2), and the club leaves (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = −1). - In phase 1 (stage < 8): 6, the qualification (0x44a, −1, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x449, 0x32) and the club leaves. - In phase 2 (8 to 11): 6, the qualification (0, 0x78, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x44a, 0x32) and the club leaves. - In the knockout (12): 1, the title (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_winners_record`, thiscall(records, club, game, end), ret 0xc) and the club leaves; 2, runner-up (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_runners_up_record`, likewise) and the club leaves; 0, the qualification (0, the `cup_round::ROUND_CODE` + 0x68 of the fixture's round in the knockout stage's round table (`.stages()` + 0x30, `.round_table()`, `cup_round::SIZE` bytes), `scale_by_round`(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)); 0xff, the elimination (0, the fixture's `fixture::ROUND_NAME`, `scale_by_round`(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)) and the club leaves.

Draws the order of the 4 phase 2 groups (`exe::utils_random`) and pairs the quarter-finals (1st of a v 2nd of b, 2nd of a v 1st of b, same for c and d), resets the 8 clubs' bookings (`exe::rulingbody_reset_bookings_for_club`), creates the knockout stage (`FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`) in slot `.stages()` + 0x30, drops the 3rd and 4th of each group (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = -1, `leave_euro_competition`), sets up the round (`exe::cup_set_up_round`) and sets `.current_stage()` = 12. `EuropeanCup::draw_quarter_finals()`, called from the next-stage routine `european_cup_advance_stage` at stage 12. The list of the 8 (calloc `exe::crt_calloc` of 8 × 4; out of memory: the error box at line 0x762) with the drawn groups a, b, c and d: 1st of a × 2nd of b, 2nd of a × 1st of b, 1st of c × 2nd of d and 2nd of c × 1st of d. Each one goes through `exe::rulingbody_reset_bookings_for_club` (thiscall(the object `[[G_DISCIPLINE]]` + 4 × `.discipline_index()`, club), ret 4). The virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (create_round_table: stage 12) and the knockout stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new` of 0xb2; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE` with the cup, 8, the list, the rounds, +4, the table, `.year()`, 0xc, 2, the extra, 0x14, 1, 0, 0, 0) into slot `.stages()` + 0x30; the list and the table freed (`exe::crt_free`). Without a stage: the error box at line 0x78a. Otherwise the 3rd and 4th of each phase 2 group leave (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = −1), the round is set up (Cup::set_up_round `exe::cup_set_up_round`, thiscall(stage, 0)) and `.current_stage()` = 12.

Allocates the list (0x11c bytes) of the entrants (`.entrant_book()`) still in the cup (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = its id): kind 1 without the round 7 entries, kind 2 all, kind 3 at stage 11; otherwise the competition's own (`exe::comp_collect_club_list`); returns the count. `EuropeanCup::collect_club_list(&out, kind)`, the Champions League's virtual +0x58. Kind 1: the entrants still in, except those of round 7; kind 2: all those still in; kind 3 at stage 11 (`.current_stage()`): those still in; in any other case the competition's one (Comp::collect_club_list `exe::comp_collect_club_list`, thiscall(this, &out, 0), ret 8). The list (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 0x11c bytes; out of memory: the error box at line 0x7b5, 0x7cf or 0x7e9, null list and 0) goes into `out`; returns the count in the low word (the high word is the list pointer's).

allocates the 71-entry list of 6-byte entries (`.entrant_book()`) and fills it with the Champions League clubs (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_EUROPEAN_CHAMPIONS_LEAGUE`) by band (`club::EURO_SEEDING`): 1 up to 16 (round 7), 2 up to 18 (8), 3 up to 19 (0xd), 4 up to 18 (0); short of 71, `.entrant_count()` = 0 and returns 0
allocates the 55 qualifying rows (`.team_table()`, `.team_count()` = 55): row i takes the club of entry 70 - i and its entry round (8 -> 2, 0xd -> 1, other -> 0); out of memory, -1

Moves to the next stage (`.current_stage()`) and draws the phase 1 groups (stage 0), the phase 2 groups (8) or the quarter-finals (12); at the last stage, the error box. `EuropeanCup::advance_stage()` (the virtual +0x28, from the cup pass 0x51f904). At the last stage (`.current_stage()` ≥ `.stage_count()` − 1, signed): the error box at line 0x495. Otherwise `.current_stage()` + 1 and, at stage 0, the phase 1 group draw (`draw_phase1_groups`, thiscall(this)); at 8, the phase 2 draw (`draw_phase2_groups`, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); at 12, the quarter-finals (`draw_quarter_finals`, thiscall(this)). The caller does not read the return value.

by the score (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`, or `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`), 2 UEFA coefficient points to the winner's nation or 1 each on a draw (`add_uefa_coefficient`); in the group stage (`.stage_index()` from 0 to 11), 200 thousand to the winner or 100 thousand each, with the prize news item (`european_cup_send_prize_money_news`); then the cup base (`exe::cup_process_fixture`)

Converts the three progress codes by stage (qualifying, phase 1, phase 2) and writes them to `.current_position()`, `.best_position()` and `.worst_position()` of the club's competition stats entry. `EuropeanCup::set_club_progress(club, stage, p1, p2, p3)` (the virtual +0x68, from the cup base `record_team_progress`): converts the three progress codes by stage and writes them into the club's record in the competition statistics (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` on +8, without checking for null, as the original) `.current_position()` ← p1, `.best_position()` ← p2, `.worst_position()` ← p3. Stage −1 (qualifying): 1 → 0x19 (p2: 1), 17 → 0x21, 33 → 0x31, 47 → 0x3f; stage below 8 (signed): 1 and 2 → 1 (p3: 0xd), 3 → 0x11, 4 → 0x19; below 12: 1 and 2 → 1 (p3: 7), 3 → 9, 4 → 0xd; the other codes and the stages from 12 on pass through unchanged.

Builds the round table: in the group stages, the 6-round schedule (phase 1 dates in September and October and phase 2 from November to March, by half) with fixture 0 of each round empty; the qualifying rounds and the knockout stay with the original. Method +0x3c of the Champions League, SEH frame for the local dates with no destructor on the normal path: `EuropeanCup::create_round_table(stage, &rounds, &id, &league)`, called from the group draws (`draw_phase1_groups`, `draw_phase2_groups`) and the predicted positions (`european_cup_rank_teams`). A person without a club (`.club_job()`) outside a loan (`.contract_type()` = 5): added to the contract club (`exe::database_add_staff_to_club` with today); on failure: 0. A new job outside a loan with no room at the current club (`exe::database_club_has_room_for_job`): the cancelled-offer news (`exe::contract_manager_post_offer_cancelled_no_space_news`) and 0. A human current club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1): the scouts' lists (`FN_SCOUT_MANAGER_SYNC_SCOUT_LISTS`) and `exe::training_manager_update_coach_assignments`. On a loan: a squad above 50, the cancelled-trial news (`exe::contract_manager_post_trial_cancelled_news`) and 0; otherwise `exe::virtual_staff_remove_virtual_players`, added with job 11, the end by the length (`exe::date_days_since` and `exe::date_add_days` from today), job 8 in the high nibble of `.squad_status()`, the start today and `exe::staff_set_squad_flags`. The end is at least 4 weeks after the start (`exe::date_add_weeks`); the end also goes to the person's `staff::DATE_EXPIRES_CLUB`. The place in the array (+0 pointer, `contract_manager_fields::CONTRACT_CAPACITY` capacity, `contract_manager_fields::CONTRACT_COUNT` count): the index from the 79-byte record; with a contract at the same club, the old terms of `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER`..`contract::SQUAD_STATUS` stay (`contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN` 0, `contract::TRANSFER_ARRANGED_FOR` −1) and, in the nation of `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL` for a non-EU player (`exe::database_is_staff_eu_national`), 100 days (`exe::date_sub_weeks`) after the person's date `staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`, the second nationality (`staff::SECOND_NATION`) becomes that nation's (with the 1st from `KEY_NATION_BRAZIL` or on a draw of 3); at another club, the type by the job, `contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN`/`contract::TRANSFER_ARRANGED_FOR`, `exe::staff_contract_reset_morale_state` and `contract::CLUB_APPEARANCES` zeroed. Without a record: the first free slot (+0 = −1) gets the contract (type by the job, `exe::staff_contract_reset_morale_state`), the record, the payroll (`exe::finance_update_wage_bill`) and 1; otherwise at the end (grows by 100, realloc `exe::crt_realloc` or malloc `exe::crt_malloc`; without memory, box 0x1637). Then: the value (`contract::WAGE`) in the person's `staff::WAGE`, the morale (+0x14, `exe::staff_adjust_morale`) in type 2 with a player sheet, the payroll (`exe::finance_update_wage_bill`), and with a new job the departure from the current club (`exe::database_remove_staff_from_club`) and the arrival at the contract club (`exe::database_add_staff_to_club`); on failure: the box (0x1672, 0x167a) and 0.

`contract_manager_offer_contract(person, club_arg, out, slot, factor, mode)` (SEH frame for the local STAFF_CONTRACT without a destructor; x87): the contract the club offers: the desired contract × factor, the minimum release fee, the cap, the end date by age, the total by age and the value capped; returns the terms or makes the offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer`). Without a club, the club of the person's contract (the 79-byte record in `G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE` → the 0x50-byte contract in `[[G_CONTRACT_MANAGER]]`, kept in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`); none: 0. A national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`), a flagged regen (bits 0x30, `staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`, of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the record), the club itself outside types 11..15 (`exe::database_is_player_job` of `.job_for_club()`) with the club's list at 2 or without staff (`club::MANAGER`) and manageable (`exe::club_can_be_managed`), a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) or a future transfer (`exe::transfer_manager_get_future_transfer`): 0. The desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract` into the local, with the status `exe::shortlist_manager_get_squad_status_for_club`; a 3 with ability (`.current_reputation()` of the sheet) above 5250 becomes 2); a return equal to `rdata::F64_0`: 0. The wage (`contract::UNKNOWN`) and the value (`contract::WAGE`) × factor. With a signing-on fee (`contract::MINIMUM_FEE_RC`): the minimum release fee (`contract::RELEASE_FEE`) by the value of the slot's offer (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value`: in bands of 50 thousand, 1 million and 5 million) or 50 thousand without an offer (100 thousand below the 1st band); without a signing-on fee, with `contract::RELEGATION_RC` or `contract::NON_PROMOTION_RC`, 50 thousand. The cap: the club's maximum wage (`exe::finance_get_max_wage`, with the job from the high nibble of `contract::SQUAD_STATUS`) × (factor + 1) × 0.5 for status 11, otherwise the staff one (`exe::finance_get_max_staff_wage`). The current contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`). A player (`.player()`): the age in days (`exe::date_days_since`) × k minus the sheet's weight (type 0x14 (`.goalkeeper()`) fixed, otherwise `.stamina()`, `.natural_fitness()` and the person's `.professionalism()`): above `rdata::F64_34` (or a current contract with nibble 6) the end next year (value × `rdata::F64_1_1`; bonus × `rdata::F64_1_25`); above `rdata::F64_31`, in 2 years (bonus × `rdata::F64_1_3`); above `rdata::F64_29` with the club's reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) above the sheet's (`.world_reputation()`) × `rdata::F64_1_2`, the year by age (bonus × `rdata::F64_1_5`). A value above 10 thousand and an age above `rdata::F64_30`: the total (weeks to the end × value) against ability and age (pow `game_pow`): reduces the value for each 52 weeks fewer or lowers the cap to total / weeks. A current contract that ends later: 0; an injury (`FN_INJURY_GET_PLAYER_INJURY`) above 70 days (`injury_entry::DAYS_LEFT`) with `G_INJURY`: 0. With `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_IN_FORCE` = 1, at most 5 years. A value above the cap × `rdata::F64_1_4`: 0; above the cap: the wage and the bonuses × value / max(cap, 1) and the value = cap. The grievances cleared (`exe::staff_contract_clear_all_grievances`). With `out`: copies the contract and 1; otherwise, in mode 2, or with a current contract in mode 1 that ends before today + 150 days, the offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer`); 1.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::update_after_match(game, summary)`, called by the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`): after each match, contract bonuses, happiness by minutes played, morale by a draw and by the result, and the development and happiness of those left out. With the match's `.home_side_mark()` and `.away_side_mark()`, the winner by the score (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`; with `.home_goals_extra_time()` = −1, `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`) and a copy of the 50 squad slots (`club::SQUAD`) of each club. The winner (and the loser) draws (21 − `staff::AMBITION`) below 4 for +3 (−3) on morale `contract::MORALE`; the person leaves the squad copy. Then, those left in the copy (with a player sheet, a contract, without suspension `exe::discipline_is_player_banned`, injury `exe::injury_get_player_injury_status`, national duty `exe::nationalteams_get_international_duty_club` or loan) develop (`exe::update_player_reputation_after_match` with the average rating `G_PLAYER_STATS` − 1), `contract::UNHAPPY_FLAG` counts and, from 8 (14 with a partner), outside the human club and the partner, they leave the first team (`exe::contract_manager_get_squad_placement` 2 or 4 → `exe::contract_manager_toggle_squad_placement`); the happiness drops 8 and the morale drops.
the morale of the player record (`.player_morale()`), for the screens

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::calc_player_value(person, club, mode, ability, _)`: the player value by peak age and age, record ratings, ability as seen by the club manager, club nation, contract days left and release clause. The main contract goes to `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT` and the contract with his club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`, into the incoming `this`). Without a player sheet (`.player()`): the compensation (`exe::transfer_manager_calc_compensation_fee` with 1) by the contract club, or 0. The base and the peak age by the sheet's positions (`.attacker()`/`.attacking_midfielder()`/`.midfielder()`/`.defensive_midfielder()` ≥ 15: 13, 11, 10, 9 million; goalkeeper `.goalkeeper()` = 20: 6 million, 33; otherwise 8 million; peak 28 or 29). The age factor (peak − age, with the correction above `rdata::F64_5`) × the sheet's ratings (`player_sheet::FLAIR`, `.finishing()`, `.vision()`, `player_sheet::PLAYER_PACE`, `player_sheet::LEADERSHIP`, outside goalkeepers) and `.injury_proneness()`²; the reputation (`.home_reputation()`) limits the factor. The ability: without a club, the current one (`.current_reputation()`); with a club, the one seen by the manager (`exe::match_man_judge_player_ability` if `ability` = −1, with the seen reputation `exe::database_get_staff_reputation_for_viewer`) × 50 + the reputation + up to 5000 × factor, × `rdata::F32_0_3333333433`, between 1 and 12000; the potential (`.world_reputation()`) above 5000 (and 8000) before the peak pulls it up. Value = ability² × base × the table 0x9a7f30 (by age, with experience `.int_apps()`/`.nation()`) × the club's nation (`.nation()`: `nation::STATE_OF_DEVELOPMENT` and `nation::LEAGUE_STANDARD` or the division `.reputation()`; without a club, draw(3) + 1), with a floor. `mode`: the nation `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL` and the clause.
