`CONTRACT_MANAGER::schedule_offer_decision(id, slot)` (SEH only for the local date, with an empty destructor): finds or creates the person's type 3 decision entry and sets the day and time slice of the answer: by the offer deadline, or without an offer by today and the contract end; at most 14 days ahead. The person's type 3 decision entry (find_type3_decision, with the limit of today + 14; without one, a new one at today + 1 + draw(5), slice 2, through `exe::contract_manager_add_decision_date`). With the offer's slot (`exe::transfer_manager_get_offer_slot`): the answer deadline (`exe::transfer_manager_get_offer_response_delay`: days × 3 + slices) against what is left (days until the date × 3 + slices, `exe::date_days_since`); the smaller, at least 1, becomes the date (today + quotient of ÷3) and the slice (+ remainder; passing 2 it goes to the next day); an offer with `offer::PRE_CONTRACT` and fewer than 4 days: today + 4 + draw(2). Without a slot (−1): once the date is reached, it becomes today and the slice goes up (up to the day's `G_CURRENT_DAY_SLICE`); if the person's contract ([this] + 80 × index from the 79-byte record) ends before today + 180, today + 4 + draw(4). At the end, the date is no later than today + 14, and `contract_manager_fields::DECISIONS_ADDED` goes up.

Returns the category 1..8 of player `p` in contract `c`. Without a player sheet (`.player()`), 7; without a contract, 4; a type 5 contract (`.contract_type()` & 0x3f), 8; otherwise by the squad status (`.squad_status()` >> 4, 0..6; above, 7), the happiness (`.happiness()`, signed), the age (`.age()`), the ambition (`.ambition()`) and the sheet's reputation (`player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, `player_sheet::WORLD_REPUTATION`).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_transfer_listed_news(player, club)` (SEH frame for the local list), called by the transfer request (`handle_transfer_request`), the player put up for sale (`transfer_list_player`), the news (`exe::newsitem_auto_respond`) and 0x4dc3a0: posts news item 0xbea of a player on the transfer list, with the price and the strongest interested clubs, to the interested human clubs. Without a player, a player sheet (`.player()`), a club or the staff (`.manager()`): nothing. Without a contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`): nothing. The news item 0xbea (local): 0 the club, 1 the player, 2..4 his `names::ID` of `.first_name()`, `.second_name()` and `.common_name()`, 5 the staff, 6..8 its `names::ID`, 9 the contract `contract::GRIEVANCES`, 10 the high nibble of `contract::SQUAD_STATUS`, 11 the positions (exe::formation_get_position_mask(`position_mask`) as i16), 12 a draw of 2 (`exe::utils_random`). The price: the value (`.value()`) with a human club, when the player is not on the club's list (`exe::staff_is_transfer_listed`) or the contract has nibble 1; otherwise the asking price (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_CALC_ASKING_PRICE`) × (draw of 0x29 × `rdata::F64_0_01` + `rdata::F64_0_8`) truncated, rounded down to 10 thousand (between 10 thousand and 200 thousand, exclusive), 100 thousand (below 1 million), 250 thousand (below 5 million) or 1 million; 13 the price. From 500 thousand up: the interested clubs (`exe::shortlist_manager_collect_interested_clubs`), up to 30, the computer ones and the human ones with a budget (`exe::finance_get_transfer_budget`) ≥ price × `rdata::F64_1_1`; sorted by reputation (`club::REPUTATION`); 14 = up to 3; 15.. the ids, with 1 (in place 13) if the 2nd repeats the 1st and 2 (in 12) if the 3rd repeats one of them; finally the "off the list" in the next place. The recipients (`exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` with 0x21a, up to 30, with `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER` and the sheet) and the delivery (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::schedule_loan_end(person, club)`, only from the transfers screen (0x8fbcc0): the person's loan contract ends tomorrow (type 7) and, with a human manager at the relevant club, the early return. Without a person, with an id outside the total or without the loan contract (+4 of the 79-byte record, in this's vector): the box (line 0xe4a). Otherwise the end (`contract::CONTRACT_EXPIRES`) becomes tomorrow (`exe::date_add_days` with 1; `exe::date_operator_3d`) and the type (`.contract_type()`) becomes 7 (bits 3..5 zeroed). The current contract (+0 of the record, in the vector of `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`) in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`: from `club`, the person's club (`.club_job()`) with a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`, stdcall: ecx = [0xb7431c] is not read); from another, the current contract's club (read again twice) with a human manager: the return (`exe::contract_manager_post_loan_recall_news`: push club; push person; mov ecx, this).

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_contract_end_news(p, kind, amplo)` (SEH frame for the local LLIST and news item), called by the end of a contract, trial or loan (0x4c7ac0): posts news item 0xbb9 to the club, the interested clubs or, for famous players, the nation's managers or everyone. Without a contract or without its club: nothing. The news item 0xbb9: the contract club, the person (the id and the three keys), the kind, the contract club for kind 6 (otherwise −1) and `amplo`. Wide (`amplo`), with a player sheet: world reputation (`.world_reputation()`) above 7000, to all managers (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); national (`.current_reputation()`) above 7000, to the managers of the person's nation, of the club's and of the current club's (`.club_job()`) (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`) and to the interested clubs (`interested_club_ids`) of other nations. Otherwise to the club, to the current club for kind 6 and to the interested clubs (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Sends the club international report news: the match squad is sorted by club; each group of the same club becomes news 0x24 to its manager: the match data, the star player, how many, up to 4 players (the star first, the others by how they did), random(2) and the codes; the group players leave the array. Ret 0x18; SEH frame for the local news item: `NationalTeams::send_club_international_report_news(club, game, result, highlight, squad, count)`, from the result between national sides (`record_international_result`), for each side. The squad (a vector of `count` persons, the low byte) is sorted by club (`exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_by_club`); each group of players of the same club becomes news 0x24 to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): the match record for the club (`exe::fill_match_record_from_fixture`, only once) and its data (`exe::write_match_record_to_news`), the star player (`highlight`: id and keys, if he is from the club; otherwise −1 in the four), how many there are, the club, up to 4 players (the star first, the others by the code of how they did, from highest to lowest), 0x420e9, random(2) and the codes. The group's players leave the vector (zeroed).

Posts the call-up news: the called-up players (flag 4, or 8 for the second team) of human-managed clubs, grouped by club, become news 0x1d to the manager: national side, club, type, how many, the opponents (given list or built by `exe::national_teams_collect_fixture_opponents`) and up to 3 players. Ret 0x1c; SEH frame for the local news item: `national_teams_post_call_up_news(national_team, second, game, kind, sem_adversarios, adversarios, count)`, from the call-up (`select_squad`) and from the screen. Of the 50 slots of the national side's squad (`club::SQUAD`, pointers), each player with the flag (`.playing_squad()`: 8 for the second team, otherwise 4) and a club with a human manager (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`) joins his club's group; when the next one in the slot is not from the same club (or lacks the flag, or the list ended), news 0x1d goes to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): the national side, the club, `sem_adversarios`, the kind, how many, `second`, how many opponents and, with fewer than 4, their ids (from the given list `adversarios` or built once by `exe::national_teams_collect_fixture_opponents` with the match, when there is no list and no `sem_adversarios`), and up to 3 players (id and keys). The list built here is destroyed and freed at the end (`exe::drop_llist`, `exe::crt_operator_delete`).

Returns a new list with the match opponent (its nation's first team, for the second team) and the opponents of the fixtures from tomorrow to 13 days later that are not finals. Ret 8; SEH frame for the local list: `national_teams_collect_fixture_opponents(national_team, game)`, from the call-up news (`national_teams_post_call_up_news`) and from the request to the manager (`exe::national_teams_post_squad_request_news`). A new list (`exe::crt_operator_new` with 0xe, `exe::new_llist`) with the match opponent (the away side if the home side is from the national side's nation, otherwise the home side; for the second team, the main national side of its nation, `exe::database_get_national_u21_team`) and the opponents of the national side's other matches from tomorrow to 13 days later (`exe::fixture_manager_find_fixtures`, with byte `.home_side_mark()` of the match) that are not final-stage matches (the nine national side competitions). Returns the list.

The national squad selection (senior, B/Olympic or under-21): in the finals the list item; the squad dates, the ages and the size; with a human manager, the request to him; otherwise those from another side and the flagged ones leave, the pool list goes to the slot assignment and each picked player who fits the slot joins the squad (leaving the previous side and the tactic slots); the sorting, the news and the tactic slots. Approved fix of the original (01/11/2026): position codes also for 23- and 25-man squads (the original left stack leftovers in the slots from the 22nd on): the original 22 plus, in order, 0x202, 0x88 and 0x808, the slots the 24 table has beyond the 22 table. Ret 0x14, about 4.9 KB; SEH frame only for the local dates, no destructor: `NationalTeams::select_squad(nacao, kind, data, p, forced)`, from the call-up (`select_squads_for_fixture`, in Rust: nation `club::NATION` of the side, type, `G_CURRENT_DATE`, fixture, 0), from building the tables (0x76a840: fixture 0) and from the news (`exe::newsitem_auto_respond`: forced 1). Type 0 senior, 1 B/Olympic (flag 8, tactic team 1), 2 under-21 (`exe::database_get_national_u21_team`). Without `forced`: in the final stages (`.competition()` of the fixture in one of the 9 keys) an item (team, competition, match date − 10, 1000) goes into the list at +0 (`exe::llist_add_tail`, created with `exe::new_llist` if missing); the squad date for the type (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_DATE` of the record: today − 1 without a fixture, the match date in type 0 and above 2, the match date − 1 in types 1 and 2, which first mark both nations in vector `national_teams_fields::OLYMPIC_NATION_MARKS` at the Olympic Games or release the flagged under-21 player, `exe::nationalteams_release_overage_u21_players`) and today's (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_STAMP_DATE`); the ages and the size (`exe::national_teams_get_squad_size_limits` into +0x42/`national_squad_record::CALLED_UP_MARK`). With a human manager who decides (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`, `exe::human_manager_controls_all_national_teams`; or through the main national side for a B team without a manager): players injured for more than 10 days (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 2, `exe::injury_get_player_injury` `.training_days_left()`) leave the squad; if it is still his, the request to the manager (`exe::national_teams_post_squad_request_news`) and stop. Otherwise: the slot codes (squad_position_codes, with the 23 and 25 fix); those from another team leave the squad, those with the flag and, in type 0 with bit 1 of `.flags()` of the fixture, those without it (`exe::tactics_remove_player_from_selection` and `staff::PLAYING_SQUAD`/`staff::NATIONAL_JOB`/`staff::JOB_FOR_NATION`); the pool list (collect_squad_candidates) goes to the slot assignment (`FN_MATCH_MAN_ASSIGN_PLAYERS_TO_POSITIONS`, mode 0x2100914 in type 1, 0x2000814 in 0 and 0x814 in 2); each picked player who fits the slot (`exe::formation_get_position_mask`) joins the squad: he leaves the previous team (slot, `exe::national_teams_can_change_squad`, `exe::tactics_remove_player_from_selection`) or his own tactic slots (`exe::tactics_get_selected_player`/`exe::tactics_clear_selection_slot`, `exe::national_teams_can_change_squad`), gets the flag (`exe::staff_set_squad_flags`), the team and `staff::JOB_FOR_NATION` (0xc from 5 or 0xc, otherwise 0xb) and +9 of the 79-byte record goes to 0..100. Finally the squad is sorted (`exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_by_club`), the news (`exe::national_teams_post_call_up_news`) and the tactic slots with those not in the team are cleared. The error boxes (lines 0x748 and 0x76b) as the original.

Returns the national side holding the player from the day before to the day after (a national side fixture in the window, against the given opponent if any, or a call-up already started) or the MLS all-star squad on the game date; writes the comment; otherwise 0 (and 0 for a national side or all-star club). Ret 0x14: `NationalTeams::get_international_duty_club(player, data, club, comentario, opponent)`, from the line-up (`starters`, `select_automatically`), the scouts, the transfers and the screens. With a temporary list (`exe::new_llist`, destroyed at the end by `exe::drop_llist`). Club is a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`) or one of the all-star teams (id in `G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_EAST`/`G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_WEST`): 0. The window goes from the day before (`exe::date_sub_days`) to the day after (`exe::date_add_days`). Called-up player (`.national_job()`, the national side): the national side's matches in the window (`FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_FIND_FIXTURES`, side by bit 4 of `.playing_squad()`: set 1, otherwise 0; the days and years as the original's dwords); with a match and no opponent, or with the opponent (`fixture::COMPETITION` of the match) among them, he is on duty (text 0xa62ff4 into `comentario`, `FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) and returns the national side. With bit 4 set, the call-ups of list `[this]` (+0 the national side, +4 the opponent, +8 the date) with his national side (and the opponent, if given) and a date before the requested one: he is in the team (text 0xa62fc8) and returns the national side. Otherwise the all-star team (competition `[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE + 4·[KEY_CLUB_COMP_AMERICAN_MLS_ALL_STARS]]`: the match date through record `.round_table()`, day +3 and year +5 + year `.year()`, `exe::new_date`) for a club player (`.club_job()`) of league `KEY_CLUB_COMP_AMERICAN_MAJOR_LEAGUE` (`.division()`), with the date in the window: the 50 names (`club::SQUAD`) of both teams (first `G_KEY_CLUB_MLS_ALL_STARS_WEST`; text 0xa62fa4 into 0xde1f64 if there is a `comentario`). Otherwise 0.

Tells whether the player may play for the manager's national side: nationality, under-21 age, current call-up and the second-nationality rule. Stdcall, ret 8: `national_teams_player_is_eligible(player, manager)`, from the player search (0x7afa70, 0x807450) and from the comparison screen. No player sheet (`.player()`), no national side for the manager (`.national_job()`) or it not being a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`): 0. Already called up for it: 1. A national side of the second set (`exe::club_is_national_team`, the under-21) and age (`.age()`) above 21: 0. With `.int_apps()` or `extra_flags::PLAYED_U21_INTERNATIONAL` (bit 2) of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the person's 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`), the nationality (`.nation()`) must be that of the national side (`.nation()`); called up for another national side of another nation: 0. The national side's nation must be the first or the second (`.second_nation()`) nationality; if the nation is `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL` and so is the second: 0. Otherwise 1.

Adds to a list each duty competition it does not yet hold and returns how many were added. Ret 4: `NationalTeams::collect_duty_competitions(out)`, from the scouts (0x7f7010). Without the call-up list `[this]` or without `out`: 0. For each call-up, its competition (+4) goes into `out` (`exe::llist_add_tail`, 4 bytes) if it is not there yet; returns how many were added (byte).

Selects the squads for a fixture: from two weeks before the match, for each side, a senior, B/Olympic or under-21 squad at most 14 days old and flagged only moves its date up to the match; otherwise asks for a new one (`select_squad`); releases the over-age under-21 players and clears duplicates. Ret 4; SEH frame without a destructor: `NationalTeams::select_squads_for_fixture(p)`: without flag `.home_side_mark()` with bit 1 of `.flags()`, or with a B national side at home (`exe::club_is_national_team`) with bit 2, nothing. Only from two weeks before the match (`exe::date_sub_weeks` over date `.day()`/`.year()`). Home side: outside a B national side, the senior squad (refresh_or_select_squad type 0) and, without bit 2, the release of the under-21 players (`release_overage_u21`) of both nations; the smaller squads (refresh_minor_squads). Away side: the same without the release. Finally deletes the duplicates (`exe::national_teams_remove_duplicate_squad_entries`) of both.

With a human manager at the player's club, sends news item 0x21 (the player, the national side and the slot) to the manager of club `.club_job()` and of the contract club. Stdcall, ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor: `national_teams_post_player_called_up_news(player, nation, slot)`: only with a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`) at the player's club `.club_job()` or at the contract club (which must exist). News 0x21 (local): 0 the id, 1..3 the `names::ID` of `.first_name()`, `.second_name()`, `.common_name()`; slot 0: 4 the senior national side (`exe::database_get_national_team`), 5 = 0; slot 1: the senior side and 1; other: the B team (`exe::database_get_national_u21_team`) and 0. Delivered to the manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`) of `.club_job()`, if any, and to that of the contract club when it is another one.

Records a result between two national sides: counts each nation's match; by competition, marks the general record, swaps the nationality or, in real internationals, scores the FIFA ranking and adds caps and goals to everyone who played; clears the type's +0x44 on its date and sends the news to the clubs. Ret 8: `NationalTeams::record_international_result(p, m)`: only between two national sides (`exe::database_is_national_team`). By the fixture's competition (`.competition()`): that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_B_INTERNATIONAL` marks `staff_state::B_INTERNATIONAL_PLAYED` = 1 in the general record of those who played; that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UNDER_21_INTERNATIONAL` sets `extra_flags::PLAYED_U21_INTERNATIONAL` (bit 2) of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` and swaps the nation (+0x1a/+0x1e, `swap_to_club_nation`); that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_OLYMPIC_GAMES` nothing; the others: the FIFA ranking (`exe::fifa_rankings_record_match_result` on `national_teams_fields::FIFA_RANKING`) and, for those who played, the first call-up (`exe::staff_records_add_first_cap_record` with the opponent, if `staff::INT_APPS` = 0, after the nation swap), a cap (`staff::INT_APPS`) and the goals (`staff::INT_GOALS` += `.goals()` of the slot) for the national side and the match in the record (`exe::transfer_manager_record_international_appearance` with the nation's number of matches). In all of them, the nation's match count (+2) goes up. Then, per side: the type (1 if `.home_side_mark()` = 0; otherwise 2 for the second team `exe::club_is_national_team`, otherwise 0); on the type's date (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_DATE` + 20 × type, `exe::date_operator_3d_3d` with today's) zeroes +0x44 + 20 × type; the news to the clubs (`exe::nationalteams_send_club_international_report_news`) with the star player (slot `match_record::HOME_CAPTAIN`) and the list of those who played. No SEH, no box, no random draw.

Writes the squad name (Main, B, Under 21 or Under 23), in lower case when asked. Ret 0x14; `this` is not read: `NationalTeams::format_squad_label(kind, sub23, out, size, minusculo)`: size below 20: the box (line 0x1c98). Writes (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) the squad name: type 0 "Main", 1 "'B'", others "Under 23" (with `sub23`) or "Under 21"; with `minusculo` = 1, in lower case.

Withdraws an injured player: with 14 or more injury days, removes the call-up from the national tactics and squad; before the squad date, tells his club, opens the slot and calls up a replacement or asks the human manager. Ret 8: `NationalTeams::withdraw_injured_player(p, days_arg)`: with 14 or more days of injury, the called-up player (`.job_for_nation()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`, 0xb) of the national side's club (`.national_job()`) leaves: with an injury of type 0x51 he only leaves the tactic (`exe::tactics_remove_player_from_selection`, twice) and the squad (`exe::nationalteams_remove_player_from_squad`). Otherwise, only before the type's date (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_DATE` of the type record: `[this+4]` + 0x6e × nation id + 20 × type; `exe::date_operator_3e` over `G_CURRENT_DATE`) and if list `[this]` does not have the club with a date already past: the news to his club (`exe::national_teams_post_player_withdrawn_news`), the removal, the type's open slots (+0x45) go up 1, the level (`exe::national_teams_get_position_group`) and, if the national side's manager is human and decides (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`, `exe::human_manager_controls_all_national_teams`), the request for a replacement (`exe::national_teams_post_replacement_needed_news`); otherwise the replacement (`exe::nationalteams_call_up_replacement`) and the repeated call-ups deleted (`exe::national_teams_remove_duplicate_squad_entries`). Without a club: the original routine (box and 0).

Builds news item 0x20 (the player left the national squad injured) and delivers it to his club and his contract club when human-managed. Ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor; `this` is not read: `national_teams_post_player_withdrawn_news(p, nation, kind)`: if the player's club (`.club_job()`) or the contract club (`club_of_player_contract`) has a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`), builds news 0x20 in a local (`exe::new_newsitem` with 0): data 0..3 the player and those of +4/+8/+0xc, 4 the national side's id (senior `exe::database_get_national_team` in types 0 and 1, otherwise `exe::database_get_national_u21_team`), 5 = (type == 1), 6 the injury severity; delivers it to club `.club_job()` and, if it is another one, to the contract club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Builds news item 0x22 (a replacement is needed) with the team, squad count, level and type, and delivers it to the national side's human manager. Ret 0x10; SEH frame without a destructor; `this` is not read: `national_teams_post_replacement_needed_news(p, nation, kind, level)`: news 0x22 to the national side's manager: data 0..3 the player, 4 the team id (type 1: senior with flag 8 and 5 = 1; type 0: senior, otherwise the under-21 `exe::database_get_national_u21_team`, flag 4 and 5 = 0), 6 the injury severity, 7 = 0, 8 those in the squad with the flag (`exe::database_count_club_squad`), 9 the level, 0xa the type and 0xb the nation id. Delivered to the team if its manager is human (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), otherwise to the senior side if its manager is.

Tells whether the player may join or leave the squad now (retired, other nation, full squad, injured, squad window, date and match day, human manager) and writes the reason. Ret 0x18; SEH frame with the local list of the match search: `national_teams_can_change_squad(nation, kind, p, entrando, msg, size)`: a player (if any) retired from the national side (`exe::staff_dislikes_club`) or from a club of another nation cannot change (0). The team of the type (0 and 1 the senior side, type 1 with flag 8 and the second team; otherwise the under-21 `exe::database_get_national_u21_team`, flag 4). Joining (`entrando`): a full squad (`exe::database_count_club_squad` against +0x42 of the type record) or an injured player (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 2) cannot change. Can change (1): joining with open slots (+0x45), the type with no window (+0x44 = 0), the type's date (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_DATE`) already past or, on the day itself, a team match today (`FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_SCAN_FIXTURES` into a local list); in types 1 and 2 with a human manager who decides (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), also when list `[this]` does not have the team with a past date and he does not allow it (`exe::human_manager_controls_all_national_teams`). The reasons go to `msg` (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`). Without a nation, or `msg` with fewer than 0x32 bytes: the original routine (box and 1).

Tells whether the player is in the squad of the type (senior, second or under-21) with the type's flag. Stdcall, ret 0xc: `national_teams_player_in_squad(p, nation, kind)`: 1 if the club of the player's national side (`.national_job()`) is the team of the type (0 and 1 the senior side `exe::database_get_national_team`, 2 the under-21 `exe::database_get_national_u21_team`) and he has the type's flag (`.playing_squad()`: 4 in types 0 and 2, 8 in 1). No club or another type: 0.

With nation and finals both non-null, appends the pair to the new qualifiers list (`national_teams_fields::NEW_QUALIFIERS`). Ret 8: `NationalTeams::add_qualified_nation(nation, stage_final)`: with both non-null, appends the 8-byte record (nation, stage_final) to the list of new qualifiers at `national_teams_fields::NEW_QUALIFIERS` (LLIST, `exe::llist_add_tail`).

In the call-up record list, those of the competition (+4) end tomorrow (`call_up_entry::DUTY_END_DAY`, the day from `exe::date_add_days`). Ret 4: `end_duty_for_competition(comp)`: in the call-up record list `[this]`, those of the competition (+4 equal to *comp) end tomorrow (`call_up_entry::DUTY_END_DAY`). No SEH, no box, no random draw; the local is the date that `exe::date_add_days` writes.

In each club record (`national_teams_fields::CLUB_CALL_UP_RECORDS`, 6 bytes), drops the expired entries (`exe::date_operator_3c`) at the start, moves the rest down (`exe::call_up_record_assign`) and frees the emptied buffer. `prune_club_call_up_records()`: each club record (`national_teams_fields::CLUB_CALL_UP_RECORDS`, 6 bytes: +0 vector of 9-byte entries, +4 flag, +5 count, signed byte) counts the entries already expired (`exe::date_operator_3c`: their date before `G_CURRENT_DATE`; the routine assumes they are at the start), moves the others down over them (`exe::call_up_record_assign`) and decreases the count; zeroed with a vector, frees the vector (`exe::crt_free`) and zeroes +4 and +0. No SEH, no box, no random draw; the local (the expired count) is zeroed before being read.

the first of the 50 free squad slots of the team (`club::SQUAD`; type 0/1 the senior team, else the under-21) takes the person, who gets the team (`.national_job()`), today's date (`staff::DATE_JOINED_NATION`), mark 0xb (`.job_for_nation()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`) and squad bit 4 or 8 (`exe::staff_set_squad_flags`)

Removes the person from the team tactics (`remove_from_tactics`) and, if found in a slot, empties it and clears `.national_job()`, `.job_for_nation()` and the national bits of `.playing_squad()` (`clear_national_call_up`). Ret 0xc: `remove_player_from_squad(nation, kind, p)`: takes `p` out of the team's tactic (`exe::tactics_remove_player_from_selection`, twice) and, if he is in one of the 50 slots (`club::SQUAD`), empties the slot and clears the person (`.national_job()`, `.job_for_nation()`, `.playing_squad()` & 3). No SEH, no random draw, no locals; a box only with a null team or person (`exe::tactics_remove_player_from_selection`).

Once the nation record date (`national_squad_record::U21_SQUAD_DATE`) has passed, removes from the under-21 squad everyone older than 21 (`.age()`) and clears record `national_squad_record::U21_CALLED_UP_MARK`. Ret 4: `release_overage_u21_players(nation)`: after the date of the nation record (`national_squad_record::U21_SQUAD_DATE`, both dwords; `exe::date_operator_3e` over `G_CURRENT_DATE`), each of the 50 slots of the under-21 side (`exe::database_get_national_u21_team`) with a person aged (`.age()`, signed byte) above 21 leaves the tactic (`remove_from_tactics`, twice), is cleared (`clear_national_call_up`: `.national_job()`, `.job_for_nation()`, `.playing_squad()` & 3) and the slot is emptied; finally zeroes byte `national_squad_record::U21_CALLED_UP_MARK` of the record. No SEH, no random draw; the local is `this`.

The nation's current competition (record +4) becomes −1 and, if there is a next one (`national_teams_fields::NEXT_COMPETITIONS`[id]), that one takes its place, notifying the managers (`notify_manager_manager`). Ret 4: `clear_current_competition(nation)`: the current competition of the nation record (`national_teams_fields::NATION_RECORDS` + 0x6e × id, +4) becomes −1; if there is a next one (`national_teams_fields::NEXT_COMPETITIONS`[id] ≠ −1), it becomes the current one, the next becomes −1 and the manager manager is notified (`notify_manager_manager`). No SEH, no box, no locals.

in the nations of the continent (`.continent()`), the current and next competitions that ended (competition `competition::CONTINENT` null, or stage `KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE`) become −1; empty current and a next one: the next moves up, with the notice (`notify_manager_manager`)

Calls up a replacement: in the pool of the level, the first eligible player of the nation who plays a position of the one leaving (`exe::formation_get_position_mask`) is called up (`exe::nationalteams_add_player_to_squad`, leaving another squad first through `exe::nationalteams_remove_player_from_squad`) with the news (`exe::national_teams_post_player_called_up_news`); nobody: clears the type's slot count (+0x45). Ret 0x10: `call_up_replacement(nation, kind, level, saindo)`: in the section of the level (`national_team_level`) in the type's pool (`national_teams_fields::RESERVE_POOLS`, under-21 the next one; start +8/+0x1d of the record plus the slots of the previous levels, `national_squad_record::RESERVE_LEVEL_CAPACITY`, count `national_squad_record::RESERVE_GROUPS` (+0x15 under-21)), the first one who is not `saindo`, has a player sheet (`.player()`), likes the club (`exe::staff_dislikes_club`), is fit (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status`), is not a flagged regen (`FN_PLAYER_REGEN_GET_RETIREMENT_STATUS`) outside the senior side, is from the nation (team `.national_job()`, nationalities `.nation()`/`.second_nation()`, `.int_apps()`, `extra_flags::PLAYED_U21_INTERNATIONAL` of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record), is not suspended (`exe::discipline_is_player_banned`) and plays one of the positions of `saindo` (`exe::formation_get_position_mask`). Without a team he goes straight in; called up (`.job_for_nation()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`) for another type (2 with `exe::club_is_national_team`, otherwise bit 3 of `.playing_squad()`) only after the type's date (+0x3a; `exe::date_operator_3c`) and, for type 0, if the club allows (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`): he leaves there (`exe::nationalteams_remove_player_from_squad`). He joins (`exe::nationalteams_add_player_to_squad`), the type's slot (+0x45) goes down 1 and the news goes out (`exe::national_teams_post_player_called_up_news`). Nobody: zeroes +0x45. No SEH, no random draw; the local for the type of the other squad is written before being read (only the byte counts).

Builds the selection pools: clears the 4 levels of each nation record and puts every eligible person in the nation pool (and the under-21 one, up to 21 years and under 5 caps), also by the second nationality; full section: enters by rating, and sorts (qsort with `compare_by_rating`). `build_selection_pools()`: zeroes the counts (`national_squad_record::RESERVE_GROUPS`, `national_squad_record::U21_RESERVE_LEVEL_COUNT`) and puts 10000 in the lowest ratings (`national_squad_record::RESERVE_LEVEL_MIN_REPUTATION`, `national_squad_record::U21_RESERVE_LEVEL_MIN_REPUTATION`) of the 4 levels of each nation record (`national_teams_fields::NATION_RECORDS`, 0x6e bytes); then each person (`G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e bytes) with a nation (`staff::NATION`), a player sheet (`staff::PLAYER`), over 16 years old (`staff::AGE`), without a national side or already called up (`staff::NATIONAL_JOB`, `staff::JOB_FOR_NATION` = 0xb), in a player position (`exe::database_is_player_job` of `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`) and with a club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) joins the nation's pool (add_to_reserves) and, up to 21 years with fewer than 5 caps (`staff::INT_APPS`), the under-21 one; and again by the second nationality (`staff::SECOND_NATION`: with no caps for the first, a different one and not `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL`). No SEH, no box, no random draw; the locals are written before being read (of the rating stored in 32 bits only the short counts).
the order by club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`): no club last, clubs by id, within a club squad bit 4 before 8 (`staff::PLAYING_SQUAD`)

Takes the player out of his level pool in the nation and out of the squad, clearing his national team fields. Ret 4: takes `player` out of the national side. With a nation (`.nation()`) and a player sheet (`.player()`): in the nation's 110-byte record in `national_teams_fields::NATION_RECORDS`, the level (`FN_NATIONAL_TEAMS_GET_POSITION_GROUP` with the record and 0); if the level's rating (word +0xf + level × 4) is lower than the player sheet's (+9), looks for the player in the level's section of list `national_teams_fields::RESERVE_POOLS` (start = dword +8 + bytes `national_squad_record::RESERVE_LEVEL_CAPACITY` of the previous levels, size in byte +0xd + level × 4): found, the last of the section goes into his slot and the size decreases. Then, if called up (`.national_job()`): his slot among the 50 (`club::SQUAD`) is zeroed, `.national_job()` is zeroed and byte `.playing_squad()` keeps only bits 0..1.

Returns the player's level 1..3 for the national side by reputation and position ratings. Stdcall, ret 0xc: the level 1..3 of player `j` for the national side (0 with reputation `*rep` below 100, or 50 with `base`, or a goalkeeper rated 15 (`player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`)): 1 for sweeper (`player_sheet::SWEEPER`) or central defender (`player_sheet::DEFENDER`), 2 for defensive midfielder (`player_sheet::DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER`), midfielder (`player_sheet::MIDFIELDER`) or attacking midfielder (`player_sheet::ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER`) (rating 15 in +0x10..+0x14 of the player sheet), otherwise 3. Returns only `al`.

Returns the age limits (23/23 in youth competitions, 24/22, 26/22). Stdcall, ret 0x10: the age limits (`*minimum`, `*maxima`) of a national side in competition `comp`: 23/23 in the Olympic and youth competitions (`.competition()` with an id among the 9 keys `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_ASIAN_GAMES`…`KEY_CLUB_COMP_CONFEDERATIONS_CUP`); 24/22 with `kind` 1 or above 2; otherwise 26/22. Null pointers: the original routine (error box).

Sorts the national squad by club and adds, on the match date, how many players each club gives up (the record that stops club fixtures near that date). Ret 0xc; SEH frame only for the state, the dates have no destructor: `NationalTeams::record_club_call_ups(team, b, p)`: sorts the team's squad (`club::SQUAD`, 50 slots) by club (qsort with `compare_by_club`). With the fixture: its date (`.day()`, `.year()`; a day earlier for the second team `exe::club_is_national_team` or with `b`); counts the consecutive called-up players of each club (`.club_job()`), skipping the empty slots, the persons out of range (`G_STAFF_COUNT`) and those of another squad (`.playing_squad()` bit 3 without `b`, bit 2 with it), and when the club changes adds the previous club's count to its record (add_club_callups). The last club of the loop gets no record (as in the original).

who takes set piece `kind` (0..4) on `side` (0..1): the cell (dword) in the club's tactics row (`FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX`) at `tactics_fields::ROWS` + row × 0x91 + `tactics_row::SET_PIECE_TAKERS` + (side + type × 2) × 4. Above `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 0x52d it becomes −1; negative, 0; a person (0x6e bytes at `G_STAFF_TABLE`) without `.player()` clears the cell; from the club (`.club_job()`), in a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`) or with link `exe::nationalteams_is_national_or_all_star_team` they are returned; otherwise it clears. Null club, type or side out of range: the original (error box). Compared side by side (the cell)

Saves or restores the club's 20 instructions (dwords of the tactics row + 2) in one of 16 slots of 0x5c bytes (+0x30; used count at `tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT`), the current human's (`[G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER + [G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT] × 0x300]`; `G_STAFF_COUNT` − id − 1); when saving, the instructions become −1. Compared side by side (the slots and the row). Ret 0x10: saves (`volta` 0) or restores (`volta` != 0) the club's 20 instructions (dwords at `tactics_fields::ROWS` + row × 0x91 + 2, the row from `FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX` with `person`) in one of the 16 spaces of 0x5c bytes starting at +0x30 (club +0x30, person +0x34, used +0x38, instructions +0x3c; used count at `tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT`). The space is that of the human whose turn it is (`[G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER + [G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT] × 0x300]`): `G_STAFF_COUNT` - his id - 1, in 0..16. Saving (with `usar`), marks the space and copies; then the 20 instructions become -1. Restoring with `usar`, the space of the same club and person goes back to the table and is freed; without `usar`, frees all the spaces of the club and person. Null club: the original routine (error box); row -1: 0; otherwise 1.

copies the club's tactics row (0x91 bytes at `tactics_fields::ROWS`, row from `FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX`) to the destination. Null club: the original (error box); row -1: 0. Compared side by side
the reverse, writes the 0x91 bytes into the row (row -1 or beyond the total `tactics_fields::ROW_COUNT`: 0). Called by `store_tactic` (`store_tactic`). Compared side by side

At the end of a match with no human, adds to each club's tactic row (0x28 bytes) the games, wins, draws, losses, goals and points (3 per win, 1 per draw) and redoes the three double ratios (`tactic_stats::ALL_OUT_ATTACK_SCORE`/`tactic_stats::ATTACK_SCORE`/`tactic_stats::DEFENSIVE_SCORE`) that the AI formation choice reads. Ret 4: `Tactics::record_tactic_result(game)`, from the end of each match in the engine loop (0x6ba9a0, with the aggregate score; fixture +0 ≠ −2). Null match: the box at line 0x1f9 and 0. Home side (`fixture::HOME_CLUB`) or away side (`fixture::HOME_CLUB` + 4) managed by a human (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 0, 1, 0, 0; cdecl 5): 0. Otherwise, for each side (null club: the box at line 0x20a and continues), the match record for the club (`exe::fill_match_record_from_fixture`, into a local record that starts with the default date `exe::date_date_54a110`) is added to the club's tactic row (tactic_stats_row): +2 matches, +4 wins (+3 points in `tactic_stats::POINTS`), +6 draws (+1 point), +8 defeats, `tactic_stats::GOALS_FOR` goals for (+0x19 of the record, signed), `tactic_stats::GOALS_AGAINST` against (+0x1a); with p = matches, a = for, b = against and c = points (each at least 1), q = c/p, g = a/p, h = g·q², r = p/b: `tactic_stats::ALL_OUT_ATTACK_SCORE` = r·h·g, `tactic_stats::ATTACK_SCORE` = r·g·q²·q, `tactic_stats::DEFENSIVE_SCORE` = r·r·h (the order of the x87 operations). The computer's formation choice (`exe::match_man_choose_computer_tactic`) reads +2 and the three ratios. Returns 1.

Returns the captain stored (`tactics_row::CAPTAIN`) in the club and team row of the tactics table; no row, 0. Ret 8: `Tactics::get_captain(club, team)`, from the tactic screens (0x8a7440). Null club: the box at line 0x527 and 0. The club's row (`exe::tactics_get_club_tactics_index`, thiscall(this, club, team), ret 8; −1: 0); returns dword `tactics_row::CAPTAIN` of the row's 0x91-byte record in the tactics table (`tactics_fields::ROWS`).

Writes the captain (`tactics_row::CAPTAIN`) in the club and team row of the tactics table and returns 1; no row, 0. Ret 0xc: `Tactics::set_captain(club, &person, team)`, when applying the changes of the tactic screen (0x8a80d0). Null club: the box at line 0x579; null pointer: that of 0x581; 0. The club's row (`exe::tactics_get_club_tactics_index`; −1: 0); writes the pointed dword into `tactics_row::CAPTAIN` of the row's record (`tactics_fields::ROWS`) and returns 1.

Removes a player from the selection: empties (−1) the selection slots holding the person; with roles, also the two extra slots and the set-piece takers; the undo copies of the club and team are dropped; 1 when removed from a slot or set piece. Ret 0x10: `Tactics::remove_player_from_selection(club, person, team, papeis)`, from the contracts (change of place in the squad, loan and its end), from leaving the squad, from the automatic line-up (`select_automatically`), from the national sides, from retirement and from the transfers. No tactic row (`club_tactics_index`): 0. The 20 line-up slots (+2 of the row, ids) with the person (id at +0) become −1. With `papeis`: the two extra slots (+0x56, +0x5a: `exe::tactics_get_playmaker` and `exe::tactics_set_playmaker`) and the takers of the five set pieces on both sides (`exe::tactics_get_set_piece_taker` and `exe::tactics_set_set_piece_taker`) that are that person are emptied. The undo copies of the club and team are dropped (`drop_undo_copies`). Returns 1 if it removed the person from a slot or set piece. Null club or person: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Swaps the ids of two selection slots (0..19) and drops the undo copies of the club and team. Ret 0x10: `Tactics::swap_selection_slots(club, a, b, team)`, from the squad screen (0x46835e). Slots `a` and `b` (signed bytes, 0..19): swaps the ids of the two line-up slots (`tactics_row::SELECTION` + 4 × slot of the tactic row, `exe::utils_swap_bytes` with 4 bytes) and the undo copies of the club and team are dropped (`drop_undo_copies`); returns 1. No row (`club_tactics_index`): 0. Null club or slot out of range: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Returns 1 when the current human holds the selection undo copy of this club and team. Ret 8: `Tactics::has_selection_undo(club, team)`, from the squad screen (0x458a58). With copies (`tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT`) and the human whose turn it is (`[0xb74c26 + 0x300 × (i16)[0xb77c7a]]`): his copy (index `G_STAFF_COUNT` − id − 1, from 0 to 15, in `tactics_fields::UNDO_SLOTS`) exists (`undo_slot::IN_USE`) and is of this club (+0) and team (`undo_slot::TEAM`): 1; otherwise 0.

The club's selection slot in the tactics table becomes empty (−1) and the stored slots of the same club and team are released. Ret 0xc: `Tactics::clear_selection_slot(club, slot, team)`: slot (0..=19) of the club's line-up in the tactics table (row from `club_tactics_row`, dword at +2 + 4 × slot) becomes −1 and, with stored spaces (`tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT`), those of the same club and team (16 spaces of 0x5c bytes starting at `tactics_fields::UNDO_SLOTS`: club +0, team `undo_slot::TEAM`, used `undo_slot::IN_USE`) are released (`undo_slot::IN_USE` = 0, `tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT` − 1). Returns 1; no row, 0. Null club or slot out of range: the original routine (box).

Stores the taker of a set piece (first or second choice); without a person, clears it and the second choice moves up to the first. Ret 0x14: `Tactics::set_set_piece_taker(club, role, choice, person, team)`: taker `choice` (0..=1) of set piece `role` (0..=4) in the club's tactic row (`club_tactics_row`; dword at +0x5e + 4 × (choice + 2 × role)). With `person` (pointer to the id), writes the id. Without it, the cell becomes −1 and, if it is the first choice, the next one with a taker (> −1) moves up to it and becomes −1. Returns 1; no row, 0. Null club, role or choice out of range: the original routine (box).

Sets the two extra slots (`tactics_row::PLAYMAKER`, `tactics_row::SECOND_PLAYMAKER`) of the club's row. Ret 0x10: the two extra slots (`tactics_row::PLAYMAKER` and `tactics_row::SECOND_PLAYMAKER`) of the row of `club` in the tactics table (`FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX` with `human`; no row, 0): with `person`, `*person` goes into slot `which` 0/1; without it, the slot becomes −1 and, for slot 0, slot 1 moves down to 0 and becomes −1. Returns 1. Null `club` or `which` out of range: the original routine (error box).

Returns the club's tactic: for a human club (without +0x9a01 or with holiday option 2), the slot for the team and the manager's active block; otherwise, by the index in the club row, the preset block (below the preset count) or the club's own. Ret 8: `Tactics::get_club_tactic(club, team)`, from the formation of each match (`exe::match_man_choose_computer_tactic`), from the player's weaknesses (`staff_get_player_weakness_flags`), from the media and from the screens. A human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1) whose manager (`.manager()`) does not have +0x9a01 (`exe::human_manager_is_on_holiday`) or has holiday option 2 (`exe::human_manager_get_holiday_option`): the slot for the team (`exe::human_manager_select_tactic_slot`) and his active block (`exe::human_manager_get_active_tactic`). For the others, the index (signed word) in the club's row (id × 0x91 in `tactics_fields::ROWS`): below the count of preset tactics (`tactics_fields::PRESET_TACTIC_COUNT`) the preset block (`tactics_fields::PRESET_TACTICS`), otherwise its own (`tactics_fields::CUSTOM_TACTICS`, index − count); blocks of `formation_fields::SIZE` (0x18e3) bytes. Null club: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Returns the club's selection slot (0..19) holding the player, or 0xff. Ret 0xc: the slot (0..19) of the club's line-up where the person is: the club's tactic row (`FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX` with `team`; -1 returns 0) and the 20 slots (dwords at `tactics_fields::ROWS` + row × 0x91 + 2) compared with the id; not there: 0xff. Null club or person: the original routine (error box).

Stores the person in slot 0..19 of the club's row (`FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX`) and clears the club's pending instructions. Ret 0x10: writes `*person` into slot `slot` 0..19 of the row of `club` (`FN_TACTICS_GET_CLUB_TACTICS_INDEX` with `human`; no row, 0) and deletes, among the 16 pending instructions (`tactics_fields::UNDO_SLOTS`, 0x5c bytes: club, human `undo_slot::TEAM`, active `undo_slot::IN_USE`), the active ones of that club and `human`, decrementing counter `tactics_fields::UNDO_COUNT`. Returns 1. Null `club` or `person`, slot out of range: the original routine (error box).

Returns the slot's person; without a record, or from another nation in a national side, the slot becomes −1. Ret 0xc: the person (in `G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e bytes) of slot `slot` 0..19 of the row of `club`; 0 with no row or an empty (negative) slot. A slot with a person without a player sheet (`.player()`), or, in a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`), a person without a nation (`.national_job()`) or from another nation (+0x53, read as `.three_letter_name()`): the slot becomes −1 and returns 0. Null `club` or slot out of range: the original routine (error box).
